dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the widest mid-thoracic region to a sharp point at the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minimal undulation; edges show smooth convex curves transitioning to linear tapering at the posterior.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with low-level grey shading along the lateral margins.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Extremely low; faint, diffuse grey patches restricted to the nuchal region and lower flanks.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary white surface and darker peripheral shading.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Highly localized dark aperture at the blowhole; a secondary small dark pixel cluster is visible posterior-laterally to the blowhole.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Visible transverse indentation/crease just posterior to the melon/blowhole region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor dark-grey circular mark situated on the dorsal-right nuchal area, posterior to the blowhole.
